from itertools import permutations

NAT = ["South Korea", "France", "Britain", "Germany"]
ALL_LANGS = {"ko", "fr", "en", "de"}

# Language sets taken from the statements. Each speaker's native language is
# included. Korean "can't speak foreign languages", so only "ko". French "can
# speak German", so {"fr", "de"}. British "can speak Korean", so {"en", "ko"}.
# German "can speak the languages of our four countries", so all four.
LANGS = {
    "South Korea": {"ko"},
    "France": {"fr", "de"},
    "Britain": {"en", "ko"},
    "Germany": set(ALL_LANGS),
}


def valid(order):
    """order[i] is the nationality in room i+1. Statements are taken as true."""
    pos = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(order)}

    def neighbors(n):
        return [order[j] for j in (pos[n] - 1, pos[n] + 1) if 0 <= j < 4]

    def talk(n):
        # Neighbors who share at least one language with n.
        return [m for m in neighbors(n) if LANGS[n] & LANGS[m]]

    K, F, B, G = "South Korea", "France", "Britain", "Germany"

    # Korean: my room number > German's; no foreign languages; no neighbor talk.
    k_ok = (pos[K] + 1 > pos[G] + 1) and LANGS[K] == {"ko"} and len(talk(K)) == 0
    # French: can speak German; can't communicate with any neighbor.
    f_ok = ("de" in LANGS[F]) and len(talk(F)) == 0
    # British: can speak Korean; can communicate with exactly one neighbor.
    b_ok = ("ko" in LANGS[B]) and len(talk(B)) == 1
    # German: speaks all four languages.
    g_ok = LANGS[G] == ALL_LANGS

    return k_ok and f_ok and b_ok and g_ok


solutions = [list(o) for o in permutations(NAT) if valid(list(o))]

print("Exhaustive search over 24 room orders")
print("Valid arrangements found:", len(solutions))
for s in solutions:
    print("Room 1..4 ->", " | ".join(s))

options = {
    "A": ["Britain", "Germany", "South Korea", "France"],
    "B": ["France", "Britain", "Germany", "South Korea"],
    "C": ["Germany", "Britain", "France", "South Korea"],
    "D": ["Germany", "Britain", "South Korea", "France"],
}

print()
for label, order in options.items():
    verdict = "CHECK PASS" if order in solutions else "CHECK FAIL"
    print(f"Option {label}: {', '.join(order)} -> {verdict}")

# Explicit check of the submitted answer D against the Korean's statement.

               if 0 <= j < 4]

print("Submitted D Korean-speaking neighbors:",
      [m for m in k_neighbors if LANGS[m] & {"ko"}])
print("Submitted answer D:", "CHECK PASS" if submitted in solutions else "CHECK FAIL")
